mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to a tightening monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points month-over-month signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases do not correlate with subsequent increases in corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent increases in corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE do not correlate with subsequent increases in corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS levels above 4.5% do not correlate with subsequent negative equity returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decreases do not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following sustained increases in GDPC1.
